t: You're looking at a building on Eaton Square, in Westminster, numbered fifty-one to sixty-two. This was the home of Milton Shulman, who lived here and died here in 2004. Shulman was a Canadian author, and a film and theatre critic. He was based in the United Kingdom from 1943, so London was his home for much of his life. It's a fitting address for a writer who spent his career watching and judging the capital's stage and screen.
